nodes.summary: A *multiplicative character* of $\mathbb F_p$ with values in $\mathbb Z[i]$ is a map $\chi:\mathbb F_p\to\mathbb Z[i]$ with $\chi(1)=1$, $\chi(ab)=\chi(a)\chi(b)$ and $\chi(0)=0$; characters form a group under pointwise multiplication, with identity the character that is $1$ on $\mathbb F_p^\times$. For a prime $p$, $\left(\frac{\cdot}{p}\right)$ is the quadratic character of $\mathbb F_p$ (with value $0$ at $0$),…
nodes.title: Quartic characters of $\mathbb F_p$ with values in $\mathbb Z[i]$

nodes.summary: For multiplicative characters $\chi,\varphi$ of $\mathbb F_p$ with values in $\mathbb Z[i]$ (as in quartic characters), the *Jacobi sum* is $J(\chi,\varphi)=\sum_{t\in\mathbb F_p}\chi(t)\varphi(1-t)$. For a prime $p$, $\left(\frac{\cdot}{p}\right)$ is the quadratic character of $\mathbb F_p$.
